rootCause.reason: Phase 20S used scrollIntoView for active nav alignment inside the horizontal nav scroller. At tablet/mobile sizes it left active/relevant items at viewport edges and could push the first item partially outside the visible viewport. The scroller also had no symmetric inline padding inside the scrollable content.

changedFiles.reason: Add symmetric inline scroll space to the mobile/tablet horizontal nav without changing desktop/laptop layout or chat/prompt behavior.
Replace browser-dependent active-item scrollIntoView alignment with deterministic bounded scrollLeft positioning.
changedFiles.rollback: Restore Phase 20S scrollActiveNavigationItem implementation using scrollIntoView.
